notes:
Summary: Helmstone is a mid-sized defense telecom integrator looking to replace an aging on-prem agent assist stack with an air-gapped LLM inference solution. Priority: secure on-prem appliance that can survive DDoS-like call spikes and provide reliable token-level cost accounting.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-20: Intro call (Maya) — discovered strict air-gap + FIPS/KMS requirements.
- 2025-12-04: Security questionnaire submitted (they returned a heavy set of controls).
- 2026-01-12: Architecture deep-dive (Luis) — discussed H100 chassis, isolated NFS, no egress allowed.
- 2026-02-18: Kickoff POC (FF-2026-02-18-Helmstone-kickoff) — set acceptance criteria for latency, throughput, and failure modes.
- 2026-02-25: First POC demo (FF-2026-02-25-POC-demo) — basic agent assist & tool-calling flow demonstrated in lab; observability gaps noted.
- 2026-03-01: Sec ops call — raised FedRAMP mapping and audit log retention questions.

Technical requirements / notes:
- Workloads: live agent assist (real-time), post-call ticket summarization, secure tool-calling into internal ticketing systems.
- Latency targets: median RTT for agent assist < 150ms (request->first-token), p95 < 300ms under normal load.
- Spike profile: must handle 3x baseline concurrent sessions for 30 min windows without degraded p95 beyond 2x.
- Throughput: target 80 concurrent agents initially, scale to 400 in later phases.
- Models: prefer open transformer variants with strong instruction-following; need quantized / trimmed variants for on-prem GPU footprint.
- Routing: need fallback model chain (primary high-quality private model -> compressed fallback) when capacity constrained.
- Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency, and request traces stored locally for 2 years (audit requirement).
- Security: no external internet egress; HSM-backed key material (FIPS/KMS); SSO via SAML; signed binaries only in air-gapped package.

POC acceptance criteria (short):
- Demonstrate local-only inference for agent assist with median latency under 150ms at 80 sessions.
- Show automatic fallback to compressed model with graceful degradation under 3x spike.
- Provide end-to-end audit logs and tamper-evident retention.
- Clear runbook for upgrades and emergency rollback in air-gapped environment.

Quotes / customer comments:
- "We cannot allow any outbound telemetry that isn't explicitly approved — this is non-negotiable." — Head of SecOps
- "If you can show deterministic behavior during spikes, procurement will prioritize." — VP Operations

Open items / next steps:
- Provide POC runbook that details packaging, install steps for air-gapped site, and list of allowed outbound artifacts. (Action: Maya)
- Security team to map Redwood controls to their FedRAMP / ISO baseline (deliverable: gap matrix). (Action: Luis + security PD)
- Procurement: draft capital SOW and timeline for GPU chassis acquisition.
- Schedule canary run in isolated lab week of 2026-04-07; need sign-off from Helmstone network team.

Short friction points: procurement cycle long; hardware lead times; need to prepare an offline installer and signed packages.
